internal.title: High Kafka Consumer Lag in Accounting Service - Incident Resolved
internal.body:
At 11:27 UTC, an alert for high Kafka consumer lag was triggered in the accounting service, indicating a queue backlog issue. The lag reached 5200 records, causing delays and errors in processing. 

Diagnosis confirmed the backlog as the root cause. An operational action was taken to disable the kafkaQueueProblems flag at 11:47 UTC after approval. This resolved the backlog, reducing the lag to normal levels (5 records).

No error injection was found in related services (checkout, frontend).

The incident is resolved and normal service resumed shortly after the mitigation step.

external.title: Temporary Processing Delays in Accounting Service
external.body: Between 11:27 and 11:47 UTC, some customers experienced delays in processing transactions due to a backlog in the accounting service's message queue. The issue was identified and resolved promptly, and normal service has resumed. We apologize for any inconvenience caused.
